classifications.mutant: adapters/redb-store/src/controller_account.rs:267:39: replace match guard existing.declaration() == declaration with true in apply_controller_transaction
classifications.explanation: The transaction event contract compares every establishment declaration with the immutable existing account before application, so a different declaration for the same canonical account identity is refused before this defensive match guard is reached.

A non-active projection without a termination record cannot produce a valid reconciliation history or plan; the ordinary command path rejects that invalid state after this defensive early guard as well.
